amendment: Define best-of-N as a direct candidate-selection baseline. Calibration chooses among uniform selection and each structurally valid frozen N; evaluation applies the chosen N to the held-out-system candidate pool.
justification: The original protocol named best-of-N but did not define which policy-pressure checkpoint an optimize decision would receive. Direct best-of-N is the standard procedure and avoids introducing an outcome-dependent pressure target.
scope: Clarifies the prespecified best-of-N baseline only; the primary pressure selector, endpoint, pressure grid, and success criterion are unchanged.
